completeness_assessment.issue: The description field for product_categories.description and products.description are present but could be more detailed for analytical context
completeness_assessment.recommendation: Enhance product and category descriptions to include analytical use cases and business context

accuracy_assessment.issue: The glossary marks orders.tax_amount as PII, but the semantic model does not flag it as PII in constraints
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Review and align PII classification for tax_amount between glossary and semantic model; typically tax amounts are not PII unless they reveal individual financial details

accuracy_assessment.issue: The glossary shows TIMESTAMP(29,9) with nanosecond precision, which is consistent with the semantic model sql_type declarations
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: No action required; types are accurately aligned

accuracy_assessment.issue: The semantic model correctly documents that payments and shipments have many-to-one relationships to orders, but the ai_context warns about one-to-many from orders perspective (multiple payments/shipments per order) - this is accurate and well-documented
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Ensure downstream query developers review the double-counting prevention guidance in ai_context when aggregating across these relationships

efficiency_assessment.issue: The _source_system, _batch_id, and _loaded_at fields are repeated across all 7 tables with identical descriptions and constraints
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a reusable metadata field definition or template to reduce duplication in documentation

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics compute revenue aggregations (total_revenue, total_line_revenue, revenue_by_customer, revenue_by_product, etc.) with similar patterns - while each serves a distinct grain, the expression patterns are repetitive
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider documenting a standard revenue aggregation pattern or template that can be referenced across metrics to improve maintainability

efficiency_assessment.issue: The semantic model includes 40+ metrics, some of which follow identical aggregation patterns (COUNT DISTINCT for counts, SUM for totals, AVG for averages)
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Document metric calculation patterns or create metric templates for common aggregation types to streamline future metric additions

efficiency_assessment.issue: The ai_context provides excellent double-counting prevention guidance, but similar join patterns and aggregation logic are repeated across multiple metric definitions
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating reusable SQL fragments or common table expression (CTE) templates for frequently used join patterns (e.g., orders-to-customers, order_items-to-products-to-categories)
